ceo.name: Charles Liang
ceo.background: Born in Chiayi, Taiwan. BS EE from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology, MS EE from University of Texas at Arlington. Senior Design Engineer at Chips & Technologies (1988-1991), President of Micro Center Computer (1991-1993). Founded Supermicro in September 1993. Holds multiple server technology patents. IPO in 2007.
ceo.track_record: FY2024 revenue grew 110.4% to $14.99B, net income rose 80.1% to $1.15B. Built company from startup to major AI server infrastructure player. However: SEC charged SMCI in 2020 for widespread accounting violations ($200M+ improperly recognized revenue); Liang agreed to reimburse $2.1M in stock sale profits. In 2024, Hindenburg Research published short report alleging fresh accounting manipulation; EY resigned as auditor Oct 2024 citing integrity concerns; DOJ and SEC subpoenaed documents. Special Committee found EY concerns 'not supported by facts' (Dec 2024). BDO appointed as new auditor but issued adverse opinion on internal controls FY2024.

cfo.name: David Weigand
cfo.background: Age ~66. MS Taxation from University of Hartford, BS Accounting from San Jose State University, California CPA (inactive). Prior roles: VP at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (2016-2018), VP-Tax at Silicon Graphics International (2013-2016), CFO & VP at NEC Electronics America / Renesas Electronics America (2004-2013), CFO at Broadmedia Corp. Joined SMCI as Chief Compliance Officer (May 2018), promoted to SVP & CFO (Feb 2021).
cfo.cfo_search_status: Company pledged to search for new CFO 'immediately' after Dec 2024 Special Committee review. As of Feb 2026 (14+ months later), Weigand remains in seat with no public update on search progress. Fortune reported this delay on Feb 20, 2026.

co_founder.name: Sara Liu (Chiu-Chu Liu)
co_founder.background: Co-founded Supermicro with Charles Liang in 1993. Background in accounting and operations. Served as Treasurer until May 2019, Chief Administrative Officer (Oct 1993 - May 2019). Remains SVP and Board Director.
co_founder.ablecom_ownership: Charles Liang and Sara Liu own 10.5% of Ablecom

key_executives.name: George Kao
key_executives.title: SVP of Operations (retiring)
key_executives.note: Informed company of decision to retire effective Dec 31, 2025. Tom Xiao assumes his responsibilities.

key_executives.name: Tom Xiao
key_executives.title: Senior Corporate VP of Engineering
key_executives.note: Assumed SVP Operations responsibilities from George Kao post-retirement.

key_executives.name: Yitai Hu
key_executives.title: General Counsel & SVP, Corporate Development
key_executives.note: Appointed April 2025. Reports directly to CEO. Expanding in-house legal department.

key_executives.name: Wally Liaw
key_executives.title: Board Director (founding member)
key_executives.note: Returned to board in 2023 despite ties to 2018 accounting scandal period. One of original founding members.

members.name: Charles Liang
members.note: Founder. Dual CEO-Chairman raises governance concern.

members.name: Susie Giordano
members.note: Joined Aug 2024. Led one-person Special Committee investigation. 25+ years advising boards in tech sector.

members.name: Scott Angel
members.note: Appointed 2025. Nearly 40 years in accounting, audit, consulting. Focus on risk and compliance in tech/semiconductor.

recent_changes.event: Hindenburg Research publishes short report alleging accounting manipulation, undisclosed related party transactions, sanctions evasion
Audit Committee informed of concerns; Special Committee formed with Susie Giordano (sole member, joined board Aug 2024)
EY resigns as auditor citing inability to rely on management and Audit Committee representations
BDO USA appointed as new auditor

Special Committee completes review: 9,000+ hours by counsel, 2,500+ by forensic accountants, 4.1TB / 9M+ documents from 89 individuals. Concluded EY concerns 'not supported by facts'. Investigation cost $18.6M.
Company pledges to search for new CFO immediately; Weigand to remain until successor found
Belated filing of FY2024 10-K and FQ1/FQ2 FY2025 quarterly reports. BDO issues adverse opinion on internal controls.
Yitai Hu appointed General Counsel & SVP Corporate Development
Scott Angel appointed as new independent director (risk/compliance focus)
George Kao (SVP Operations) retires; Tom Xiao assumes responsibilities
Fortune reports CFO search still incomplete after 14+ months with no public update

insider_ownership_note: WallStreetZen reports 27.92% (includes Liang family holdings + co-founders); GuruFocus reports 7.16% (may use narrower definition). Institutional ownership ~53.3%, retail ~18.8%. Charles Liang personally estimated at $3.3B stake (Jan 2024).

insider_trading_pattern.note: FMP data shows consistent net disposition pattern. Q4 2024 notable: 5.26M shares disposed vs 3.52M acquired. Q2 2025: 1.37M disposed, 8 sale transactions. Recent quarters (2025-2026) show lower volumes with mixed acquire/dispose ratios.

compensation_highlights.ceo_structure: Charles Liang: $1 salary, no cash bonuses through at least 2029. Compensation is nearly entirely multi-year performance-based stock options with high exercise-price premiums ($4.50 was 32% above grant-date price in 2021; $45.00 was ~53% above grant-date price in 2023). Pay anchored to long-horizon operational and stock milestones.
compensation_highlights.cfo_structure: PRSUs and options linked to stock price and revenue KPIs. Cash fixed bonus at 30% to address market percentile gaps in base salary.
compensation_highlights.say_on_pay_approval: 97% approval at Jan 22, 2024 annual meeting; approved again at Jun 4, 2025 meeting

critical_risks: Dual CEO-Chairman role (Charles Liang) with no lead independent director disclosed
Two accounting scandals: 2017-2020 SEC settlement ($17.5M fine, $200M+ improperly recognized revenue) AND 2024 Hindenburg/EY resignation crisis

Related party transactions: Ablecom (Steve Liang, CEO's brother, 28.8% owner; Charles Liang & Sara Liu 10.5% owner) and Compuware (Bill Liang, CEO's brother, is CEO). $983M paid to these entities over 3 years per Hindenburg. ~99.8% of Ablecom US exports and ~99.7% of Compuware US exports go to SMCI
Former CFO Howard Hideshima (settled with SEC, paid $350K+) later rehired at Ablecom (related party owned by CEO's brother)
BDO issued adverse opinion on internal controls over financial reporting (FY2024)
CFO replacement promised Dec 2024 still incomplete as of Feb 2026 (14+ months)
DOJ and SEC subpoenas outstanding for documents related to Hindenburg allegations
Special Committee investigation was one-person (Susie Giordano only), raising independence optics questions
mitigating_factors: Special Committee found no evidence supporting EY concerns (Dec 2024) after extensive 3-month review
No financial restatements required per Special Committee findings
Two new independent directors added (Giordano Aug 2024, Angel 2025) with audit/compliance expertise
New General Counsel hired (Yitai Hu, April 2025) to expand legal function
7 of 10 board members classified as independent (70%)
CEO compensation structure heavily performance-based ($1 salary, no cash bonus through 2029)
